They can open a case, collect proof, and work with Adult Protective Services. They can also help with safety plans. Call 911 if there is danger right now. Call the non‑emergency number to report past abuse, money scams, or to ask for the Elder Abuse Unit.
resources.availability_status: Police help is 24/7; Elder Abuse Unit hours may be limited

resources.name: Texas Legal Services Center – Crime Victims and Elder Financial Safety
resources.description: Get free legal help for older people who had money taken or were hurt by crime. This group helps Texas people age 60 and older with money scams, power of attorney problems, and other abuse. They can explain your rights in simple words. They may help stop a bad power of attorney, get money back, or protect your home or income. They can also help you talk with police or Adult Protective Services. Call to see if they can take your case. Ask for help with elder financial harm.
resources.address: 1920 E Riverside Drive, Suite A-120, Austin, TX 78741
resources.availability_status: Call for current intake hours; space may be limited

resources.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid – Austin Office
resources.description: Get free legal help for low‑income people with elder abuse and money problems. They can help with stopping family money harm, dealing with debt from scams, and keeping your home or income safe. They may help with protective orders, power of attorney changes, and other court papers. Help is for people with low income in their service area. Call to see if you qualify and to start a phone visit. Tell them you are an older person hurt by family money abuse.
resources.availability_status: Often busy; call early in the day for best chance

resources.name: AGE of Central Texas – Caregiver Support and Older Adult Help
resources.description: Get help for older adults and people who care for them. They offer classes, support groups, and one‑on‑one help for seniors and family. Staff can help you spot elder abuse and money harm. They can help you plan next steps and find safe help. They also share tips on safe banking, scams, and planning for the future. Some help is free; some programs may have a cost. Call to ask what help fits your situation.
resources.availability_status: Open weekdays; call for program times and space

resources.name: Family Eldercare – Money Management and Guardianship
resources.description: Get help if you are an older person and need safe money support. They can help manage bills, protect income, and lower the risk of money harm. They may act as payee for Social Security or help with budgets. They also offer guardianship help for people who cannot safely manage alone. Help is mainly for older adults and adults with disabilities in Central Texas. Many programs are low‑cost or free. Call to ask if you qualify and what papers you need.
resources.availability_status: Some programs have waitlists; call to check current openings

resources.name: Area Agency on Aging of the Capital Area (CAPCOG)
resources.description: Get free help for people age 60 and older in Central Texas. They can explain your rights, help with elder abuse and money harm, and connect you to legal help. They also help with benefits like Medicare and other senior programs. You can talk with a helper who works with you over time. They can help you plan for safety and support at home. Call and ask to speak with someone about elder abuse or money harm by family.
resources.address: 6800 Burleson Road, Building 310, Suite 165, Austin, TX 78744
resources.availability_status: Open weekdays; some services by phone only

resources.name: Adult Protective Services – Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
resources.description: Get help if someone is hurting, neglecting, or taking money from an older person. This state group checks reports of harm to people age 65 and older, or adults with disabilities. They can visit the home, help stop the abuse, and connect you to other help. You can report even if you are not sure. You can report without giving your name. If someone is in danger right now, call 911 first. Then call this number to report elder abuse, neglect, or money harm.
resources.availability_status: 24/7 hotline for reports of elder abuse, neglect, or financial harm
